def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*np.cos(x)+p[3]/v+p[4]/(x*v)+p[5]*t*v**3+p[6]*x*v*np.cos(x)+p[7]*np.sin(p[8]*t)*v+p[9]*t*v
